Object / Material / Homepage / Smart Chen

A contact card treated as a physical object: circular-grained metal, engraved lettering, and one moving studio light.

Design perspective

Identity is carried by material as well as information. Cursor movement and device tilt reveal the finish without moving the grain itself.

Recorded development

Interaction / Motion / Homepage / (game) designer

A field of balls and platforms responds to movement, then contracts toward a point when the word is activated.

Design perspective

Gravity, collision, and response introduce game design through behavior. The click animation inherits the field already in motion.

Recorded development

  1. 2026.09.28The interactive field and its converging entrance are recorded together.Record

Interactive edition preserved 2026.10.27. Earlier development records are linked above.

Interaction / Hover / Homepage / filmmaker

Photographs and viewfinder corners form a temporary exhibition around the homepage introduction.

Design perspective

Framing connects the written identity to looking, image making, and the work collected in The Gallery.

Recorded development

  1. 2026.09.28Photography is part of the recorded interactive homepage.Record
  2. 2026.10.23The written identity changes from photographer to filmmaker.Record

Motion / Transition / Homepage + Projects → The Gallery

A viewfinder opens into an imagined museum, then resolves into the real Gallery masthead.

Design perspective

Entering a collection becomes a spatial journey. The opening frame, architecture, and destination belong to one continuous movement.

Recorded development

  1. 2026.10.14The architectural museum entrance is introduced.Record
  2. 2026.10.14The handoff into the real Gallery is refined.Record
  3. 2026.10.24The same entrance is shared with project navigation.Record

Motion / Film / Homepage / car enthusiast

A MINI Cooper S and BMW Z4 move from a narrow city street into an abstract star-grid chase.

Design perspective

The identity unfolds through vehicle character, camera placement, and editing. A continuous street preview becomes a complete short film.

Interface / Playground / 404 / Unavailable pages

The 404 page becomes a construction site where objects can be added, moved, and rotated.

Design perspective

An unavailable destination still offers something to explore. Construction is both the message and the interaction.

Recorded development

  1. 2026.10.09The construction-site 404 page is introduced.Record

Object / Cursor / Polaroid of Yesterday / Game Design Document

A folding SX-70 replaces the document cursor. It opens, enters a viewfinder, photographs the page, and ejects a print.

Design perspective

The document’s photographic subject becomes a usable reading tool. Framing and making a physical-looking print turn browsing into an act of image making.

Recorded development
